name: Knowledge Management
description: Curated answer system with governed article lifecycles that serves customers directly and assists agents mid-conversation, feeding IVR prompt content and preventing divergence between what customers read and what agents say.
roleInCenter: Single source of truth for every answer the organization gives, wherever it is spoken or displayed.

glossary.definition: Governed content unit with owner, review cycle, and lifecycle state
Policy that each fact has one canonical article others link to, not copy from
Days since last review; over threshold flags staleness risk
Real-time suggestion of article content into agent desktop matched to conversation context
Pre-approved reusable response snippet linked to KM for auditability
Customer thumbs up/down on public help content; per-article satisfaction input
Articles exposing clean structured content (steps, eligibility, amounts) so bots and AI channels quote the same truth
Article marked stale or wrong by agent or customer; enters urgent review queue
Plain-language, reading-level, and inclusive-language standards articles must pass
Queue of articles from QA root-causes, VOC drivers, or flags awaiting update

metrics.name: Article Helpfulness
metrics.definition: Helpful votes over total votes per article and aggregate

metrics.name: KM-Backed Self-Service Resolution
metrics.definition: Sessions that ended with help content read and no subsequent contact

metrics.name: Agent Assist Acceptance
metrics.definition: Share of suggested snippets used without edit in handling

metrics.name: Content Outage Rate
metrics.definition: Flagged articles per period; quality incidents in content supply

failureModes.name: Poisoned Knowledge
failureModes.signal: QA root-cause knowledge_gap clusters on specific articles; IVR and agents disagree
failureModes.mitigation: Flag-to-fix SLA; article version status surfaced to agents with last-reviewed date

failureModes.name: Silent Divergence
failureModes.signal: Customer help and internal KB answer the same question differently
failureModes.mitigation: SSOT enforcement: one canonical article, other surfaces reference it

failureModes.name: Search Dead Ends
failureModes.signal: Agent search-to-click rate low; questions routed to tier 2 for findable answers
failureModes.mitigation: Search analytics; curation backlog prioritized by failed-query volume

failureModes.name: Launch Content Gap
failureModes.signal: Contact drivers spike on recently launched products with no articles
failureModes.mitigation: Content readiness gate in product launch checklist

exchanges: Case attributes drive contextual article retrieval
Dynamic informational prompt content drawn from machine-facing articles
Knowledge-gap root causes open curation tickets; article quality feeds QA coaching
Driver themes with missing answers become content backlog items

scoringModel.name: Knowledge Grounding & Lifecycle Freshness Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates Single Source of Truth (SSOT) governance, semantic vector coverage of live contact drivers, RAG citation grounding precision, and closed-loop self-service deflection lift.

dimensions.name: Citation Grounding & SSOT Factual Precision
dimensions.description: Precision of retrieved knowledge chunks and strict alignment between customer-facing help, agent desktop assist, and bot RAG responses
sampleCriteria: Every policy or pricing fact traces to a single canonical SSOT article ID
Agent assist and CAI RAG top-3 chunk retrieval precision exceeds 90 percent
Zero divergence between external help portal and internal agent guidance

dimensions.name: Semantic Vector Coverage & Drift Control
dimensions.description: Minimization of semantic embedding distance between emerging live contact intents and indexed knowledge chunks
sampleCriteria: Mean cosine distance between live contact intents and nearest KM chunk stays below 0.18
New product and promo launches pass KM embedding readiness gate prior to go-live
Zero-click and failed search queries automatically cluster into curation tickets

dimensions.name: Article Lifecycle Freshness & Staleness Control
dimensions.description: Adherence to review-age SLAs, rapid remediation of flagged content, and automatic archival of expired announcements
sampleCriteria: Stale article share past review threshold remains under 3 percent of published corpus
Agent-flagged or QA-flagged articles enter urgent review within 4 business hours
Time-bound outage and promotional articles enforce automatic expiry timestamps

dimensions.name: Closed-Loop Deflection & Agent Assist Lift
dimensions.description: Measurable reduction in inbound repeat contacts and agent handle time attributable to article consumption and macro reuse
sampleCriteria: KM-backed self-service sessions achieve >75 percent containment without 24-hour callback
Agent assist snippet acceptance rate exceeds 65 percent on matched intents
Article helpfulness vote ratio stays above 80 percent positive

dimensions.name: Model-Aware Structure & Readability Ergonomics
dimensions.description: Clean schema chunking, scannable step procedures, and plain-language compliance enabling both fast agent scanning and zero-hallucination RAG
sampleCriteria: Articles expose structured preconditions, step lists, and eligibility tables
Reading level and plain-language scores pass style guide automated checks
Chunk boundaries preserve complete conditional rules without mid-clause truncation

stateVariables.description: Continuous cosine Wasserstein drift between the live contact intent embedding distribution and indexed KM article chunk centroids
Instantaneous hazard rate that an article of review age a becomes factually obsolete due to product or policy change
Continuous probability that a retrieved knowledge chunk entails the exact factual answer required by the active contact intent
Net self-service deflection rate attributable to grounded KM retrieval across portal, IVR, and virtual agent surfaces

differentialEquations.name: Semantic Vector Embedding Drift Dynamics
differentialEquations.formula: dD_sem(t) = (v_launch(t) - mu_curate cdot u_publish(t) cdot D_sem(t)) dt + sigma_sem dW_t
differentialEquations.interpretation: Live contact intent distribution drifts away from static KM embeddings at velocity v_launch(t) during product and policy shifts and contracts at rate mu_curate as curated chunks u_publish(t) are indexed

differentialEquations.name: Article Staleness Hazard & Grounding Precision Field
differentialEquations.formula: h_stale(a, t) = k_weib cdot lambda_age^k_weib cdot a^(k_weib - 1) + beta_flag cdot I_flagged(t), with P_ground(t) = P_max cdot exp(-alpha_sem cdot D_sem(t) - integral_0^a h_stale(u, t) du)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Article obsolescence follows a Weibull aging hazard amplified by agent and QA flag events I_flagged(t), exponentially attenuating citation grounding precision P_ground(t)

differentialEquations.name: Closed-Loop Deflection Lift Derivative
differentialEquations.formula: dL_defl(t) cdot dt^-1 = eta_lift cdot P_ground(t) cdot (1 - D_sem(t) cdot D_max^-1) - delta_decay cdot h_stale(a, t) cdot L_defl(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Self-service deflection lift grows proportionally to grounding precision and semantic coverage while decaying when article staleness hazard rises

scaleInvariants: Unit-hypersphere normalization invariance: L2-normalized chunk embeddings ensure inner-product retrieval scores equal exact cosine similarity across embedding dimensions
Sub-linear O(log M) approximate nearest-neighbor HNSW retrieval latency across corpora scaling from 1k to 10M+ knowledge chunks
SSOT referential idempotence: updating one canonical article atomically zeroes staleness hazard across all dependent IVR, CAI, and agent-assist surfaces
